note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 27(1)(b), 27(1)(c), ZAM 23(1), 23(2); A06b Const 27(1)(b), 27(1)(c), ZAM 23(1), 23(2); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Citizenship of Zambia Act, 2016 (Act No. 33 of 2016), ZambiaLII source file (legislation as at 7 June 2016), ss 20, 22, 25. It confirmed loss on taking another citizenship. It was silent on the years of residence, renunciation, birth in the territory and descent, which still rest on the sources above, re-read that day and found the same.

sources.title: Citizenship of Zambia Act, 2016 (Act No. 33 of 2016), ZambiaLII source file (legislation as at 7 June 2016), ss 20, 22, 25
sources.said: 20. Application for registration as citizen (1) A person shall apply to the Board for registration as a citizen in the prescribed manner and form upon payment of the prescribed fee. ... 22. Computation of period of residence for purposes of registration The period to be taken into account in computing a period for a person who qualifies for citizenship by registration in accordance with the Constitution and this Act is the period during which a person is ordinarily resident in Zambia. ... 25. Dual citizenship (1) A citizen may apply for dual citizenship in the prescribed manner and form. (2) Subject to Article 39 of the Constitution and this Act, a citizen who acquires the citizenship of another country is entitled to retain the citizenship of Zambia.
